summary: PO 2023 section 7 (study-plan label PO-2024 in Mitteilungsblatt 4/2025): compulsory law modules R1 to R16, economics modules W1 to W4 plus two economics electives (W5, 12 ECTS), integration modules IB1 to IB4, key competencies, and Integrated Sustainability Studies B (30 ECTS: the two basic modules of 6 ECTS plus one sustainability specialization of 18 ECTS, per AB NaS section 8(2) and section 5(1)). Schwerpunkte 23 and 24 are not available.

categories.name: Sustainability studies: basic modules
categories.note: Both basic modules are required: Grundlagen und Theorien der Nachhaltigkeit (6 ECTS) and Erkenntnistheorie und Methoden der Nachhaltigkeit (6 ECTS). The checker count of 1 is only a semester cap because Erkenntnistheorie is not offered this winter.

categories.name: Economics electives I and II
categories.note: 12 ECTS: choose two of Finanzwirtschaft, Entscheidungsorientierte Unternehmensrechnung, Marketing, Personalmanagement, Nachhaltige Unternehmensfuehrung, and Einfuehrung in die Umweltökonomik. The handbook line of 6 cp on the W5 sheet conflicts with section 7; this rule follows section 7.

categories.name: One sustainability specialization
categories.note: 18 ECTS as the full module bundle of one sustainability specialization (INS B is 30 ECTS: two basic modules of 6 ECTS plus one specialization of 18 ECTS). Take every module of the chosen specialization. That bundle is not always three modules: some specializations are two modules (8+10 or 9+9 ECTS), some are three modules of 6 ECTS, and some are four or five. In Genese und Strukturen (Schwerpunkt 6) and Wasserwirtschaft (Schwerpunkt 19), choose any three modules of 6 ECTS. In Critical Sustainability in Art and Design (Schwerpunkt 29), choose two modules of 9 ECTS. Where two modules are marked a/b, choose one. The checker count of 1 is only a shared semester cap, because some specializations offer a single module; it is not the regulation. If your specialization offers more than one module, take the whole bundle.
